summary: Built a general in-play unit-targeting Reaction primitive (Champion of Thunder / Brothers of Goemon, plus A Close Call reusing the narrower existing attack-reaction window), generalizing FindBeforeActionReactionWatcher/NegatedEffectKind (Rokai/Tamoko's own beforeActionReaction machinery) with two new branches and a new 'all'/'bow' negation vocabulary reaching StalwartNegatesBow/ApplyModifier/DestroyUnits/MoveHome/Straighten via a shared NegatesEffect helper. Wired via Follower wave 11 and Strategy wave 10 (rebased past a concurrent Follower wave 10 collision from another task). Fixed two real pre-existing gaps this surfaced: the attack Target's own blanket Personality-with-any-attachment immunity was too broad (only a Follower attachment should grant it), and AnyAttackReactionAvailable never discovered a hand-resident Strategy reactor. Also fixed tools/env.sh's own Godot-glob set -e abort, which silently broke check.sh --skip-client in any environment without Godot installed. Crosses into src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/ for the three new cards' own art JPGs, the normal content-wave pipeline's own cross-lane touch, same as every prior wave.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 178/178 core, 52/52 published (pinned count 322), 9/9 deck-format, 10/10 deck-workshop, all green. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: full pass (Python collaboration/content unittest suites, L5R.Core.Tests, L5R.AI.Tests 14/14, L5R.Server.Tests 5/5, L5R.Client.Transport.Tests 4/4) -- All requested checks passed. Four new regression tests cover Champion of Thunder negating on itself/host/sibling Follower and its own multi-affected-card choice; Brothers of Goemon's Ring gate, its no-bow-no-trigger case, and its Force-penalty-still-applies/only-bow-negated retroactive case; A Close Call's Armor+Ranged/Melee gating and Melee-too coverage. docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx regenerated (322 wired) with the three now-stale BLOCKERS entries removed.
remaining: None; ready for review. Champion of Thunder negating an Attack targeting its own unit is a documented, deliberate scope limit (see the decision doc's own Status section), same spirit as Rokai/Tamoko's own pre-existing Attack exclusion.
